messages:
Jess (Sales): Kicked off the Valencia POC run this morning per SOW. Ramp plan: 400 qps sustained for 15m with short 30s bursts to 1k. We saw p95/p99 increase during bursts. Posting raw notes and ask: can Eng explain cause of spikes and propose mitigations + updated cost estimate for Dedicated? Legal asked for data flow endpoints.

Devon (Solutions): Attached CSV with per-minute p95/p99. Quick notes: host CPU peaked ~62%, GPU util ~88% during bursts, batch sizes spiked as client retried. Raw trace excerpt:
```
[2026-03-22T17:09:12Z] node-2: kv_cache_miss -> disk_fetch 78ms
[2026-03-22T17:09:13Z] node-4: batch_size 24 -> 96
[2026-03-22T17:09:14Z] router: queue depth 220
```

Mike (Eng): Two quick suspects: (1) cold KV cache propagation across nodes causing re-computation; (2) router/backpressure when burst exceeds per-node concurrency leading to queueing and tail latency. Also saw token-gen stalls at disk fetch points for quantized weights.

Anya (SRE): Can you paste the client qps pattern and model details? Also what are autoscale settings? We should check scale cooldowns and batching window.

Jess (Sales): Client pattern: steady 400 qps then at t+9m two 30s spikes to 1k. Model: open-model-13b-8q, avg seq len 128 tokens. Autoscale: min_replicas=3, max_replicas=6, burst policy enabled. Run command used:
```
redwood bench run --qps 400 --burst 1000 --dur 900 --model open-13b-8q --min 3 --max 6
```

Mike (Eng): Ok — min 3 is undersized for sudden 1k bursts. Autoscale cooldown was 60s which is too slow here. Also quantized model disk paging + kv_cache misses explain spikes. Short-term mitigations: increase min_replicas to 4-5, reduce scale-out cooldown to 5-10s, enable prefix caching replication across nodes. Long-term: prewarm KV cache and consider fallback smaller model for spikes.

Devon (Solutions): Cost note: moving to Dedicated with min 5 nodes estimated delta ~+$12k/mo. I can produce an exact calc if we have customer's expected sustained vs peak distribution.

Jess (Sales): Customer expects sustained 350 qps, peaks to 1k for ~2% of requests. Please provide recommended config + quote for Dedicated with optional burst cushion.

Mike (Eng): Suggested config (short):
```
min_replicas: 4
max_replicas: 8
scale_in_cooldown: 20s
scale_out_cooldown: 5s
batching.max_window_ms: 10
prefix_cache.enabled: true
prefix_cache.replication: 2
fallback_model: open-6b-8q
canary_policy: shift 10% to fallback if p95 > 250ms
```

Anya (SRE): Security checklist: data flows are control plane -> api.redwood.hosted, inference -> model-serve.valencia.prod.redwood (customer VPC peered), logs -> s3-logs.redwood. We'll share IP ranges + SOC2 PDF. Devon — can you attach KMS integration snippet for Dedicated?

Devon (Solutions): KMS snippet:
```
kms: {
  provider: "aws-kms",
  key_alias: "valencia/poc"
}
```
We can also support HSM for Private deploys.

perf-bot: Load test completed: 15m run, baseline 400 qps, 2 bursts to 1k. Artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/valencia/poc/1789999000

Jess (Sales): Thanks team. Next steps: Mike -> runbook for prewarm + new autoscale settings; Devon -> cost delta + KMS doc; Anya -> network/IP ranges + SLA blurb. I'll merge into customer slide for tomorrow 10am PT. :thumbsup:
